15
Driving a car raises the temperature of the tyres.
This causes the pressure of the air in the tyres to increase.
Why is this?
A
Air molecules break up to form separate atoms.
B
Air molecules expand with the rise in temperature.
C
The force between the air molecules increases.
D
The speed of the air molecules increases.

options.label: A
options.text: Air molecules break up to form separate atoms.

options.label: B
options.text: Air molecules expand with the rise in temperature.

options.label: C
options.text: The force between the air molecules increases.

options.label: D
options.text: The speed of the air molecules increases.
